subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Robinson Crusoe did not want that he should go to sea. His father was born the idea. He wanted in England. His father did not like him to study law. to be a sailor from his boyhood.
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table to make a text (a) Robinson Crusoe was born in England. (b) His father wanted him to study law. (c) He did not like the idea. (d) He wanted to be a sailor from his boyhood. (e) His father did not want that he should go to sea.
